comment: The evidence record for private AI company figures. One file, two readers: lib/finance/private-revenue.ts types and serves it to the financial snapshot; scripts/ingest-catalogue.mjs mines it for dated catalogue observations. Nothing enters without publisher, date and verbatim quote — tests/private-revenue.test.ts enforces that. vendorClass separates calibration regimes: a data platform's valuation multiple must never calibrate a frontier lab's band.

citation.quote: On February 12, 2026 Anthropic raised a $30B Series G at a $380B post-money valuation, co-led by GIC and Coatue.
Cohere raised $500 million in venture funding, achieving a $6.8 billion valuation, led by Radical Ventures and Inovia Capital.
Mistral is reportedly in talks to raise ~EUR3B at a ~EUR20B valuation, following a $830M debt facility (Mar 2026) and its ASML-led EUR1.7B Series C.

notValuations.what: $110B in funding involving Amazon, Microsoft and Nvidia, including a $100B expansion of an AWS deal over eight years (Yahoo Finance, 2026-07-31)
notValuations.why: A compute and infrastructure commitment, not an equity round. It says nothing about what the company is worth or what it earns, and dividing it by a multiple would be meaningless.
